test_type: reconstructed expanding-window; predict whole date before ingestion
selection: Minimum validation mean log loss, with summed Brier reported alongside. Within 0.01 log loss of best, prefer frequency, Poisson, Elo, then Dixon-Coles. Frozen original is comparison only.
limitations: Single supplied season; no independently verified historic seasons. Test is unexamined at protocol declaration, but original baseline was authored retrospectively. This is not prospective validation.
